captions.detailed: This object is a rectangular sunroof cassette featuring a thick, corrugated black outer frame. Inside the frame, five parallel glass blade slats are arranged horizontally. Each glass slat is bordered by a thin black frame and is equipped with short pivot pins on its lateral edges. The slats are designed to rotate synchronously on their horizontal revolute joints, allowing the louvre system to open and close for adjustable ventilation.
captions.instruction: Generate a parametric 3D model of a lamella louvre sunroof cassette. It should feature a rectangular corrugated black frame housing five parallel glass blade slats, each fitted with horizontal revolute joints at their lateral pins to allow coordinated rotational opening.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base frame by subtracting an inner box from a larger outer box to form the rectangular cassette. Grooves are patterned on the frame sides using boolean cuts. Five glass slats are then created as individual parts, each modeled by combining a thin glass box with a surrounding frame and lateral cylindrical pins. Finally, five revolute joints are defined along the lateral pin axes to connect each slat to the frame, allowing them to rotate synchronously.
